claims.claim: Used Nikon D610 in good condition.

No battery or other included items are visible in the provided photos.

risks.risk: Shutter count / heavy usage (affects lifespan and resale value).
risks.proof: A photo of the camera’s shutter count screen (or a screenshot from a shutter-count app) plus the camera’s serial number plate.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a used body with unknown shutter count (worst-case: higher wear).

risks.risk: Sensor condition (dust, scratches, fungus) and image quality.
risks.proof: A test shot of a blank white wall at f/16 (or a proper sensor dust test image) plus a close-up photo of the sensor area (mirror up if possible).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed clean sensor (worst-case: needs cleaning).

risks.risk: Autofocus and key functions may be faulty (AF, buttons, dials, ports).
risks.proof: Video/clip showing AF working on a subject + photos showing all buttons/dials respond (e.g., menu navigation) and that the camera powers up normally.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not confirmed fully working (worst-case: may require service).

risks.risk: Missing accessories / not the claimed 'original battery' (or battery health is poor).
risks.proof: Clear photos of the battery label/model and contacts, and what exactly is included (charger, battery, cables, strap, caps).
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming minimal/uncertain accessories and battery health not guaranteed.

risks.risk: Mount/contacts damage (lens mount wear, broken pins) affecting lens compatibility.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the lens mount contacts/pins and the mount rim from multiple angles.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as mount condition unknown (worst-case: may need repair).

proof_requests: Photo of the camera’s serial number and a shutter-count screenshot/photo.
Sensor test image (white wall at f/16) and/or close-up of the sensor area.
Video clip showing autofocus on a subject and that the camera menus/buttons/dials work.
Clear photos of the included battery (label visible) and charger/other accessories listed.
response.reason: The photos confirm a Nikon D610 body and show cosmetic wear, but key value drivers (shutter count, sensor condition, full functionality, and included accessories) are not verifiable from the provided images. Without those, a reliable worst-case price can’t be set confidently.
